title: Realistic Human Heart
author: neshallads
notes: Realistic external view of the heart with great vessels and coronary vessels, photoreal wet-tissue PBR textures (1k GLB variant). Single mesh, single material 'Heart_Tex', no animation, no separable parts. Scale/orientation not checked in a viewer: normalise the bounding box on load.

title: Human Heart Internal Structure 3D Model
author: Haiqa Arif
notes: Textbook-style cut-away heart: chambers, valves, septum, red arteries / blue veins, yellow fat. HEAVY: 28 MB and ~500k triangles (over the 15 MB budget, kept because it is the only good educational cross-section found). Compress (Draco/meshopt + simplify) or lazy-load before shipping. 5 unnamed meshes (Object_4..8) sharing one AI-generated (Tripo) material, so parts are not individually labelled. No animation.

title: Realistic Human Lungs
author: neshallads
notes: Both lungs with trachea, larynx and thyroid, realistic PBR textures (1k GLB variant), same author/style as heart.glb. Two meshes (part01, part02) with two materials; no animation. Uses KHR_materials_specular. External view only, bronchial tree is not visible inside the lungs.

title: Male base mesh with muscle detail
author: C.J..Goldman
notes: Full adult male body, standing A-pose, neutral grey-blue sculpt look, clear pectoral/sternum landmarks for compression point and AED pad placement. Not anatomically explicit. Single mesh (Object_2), one material, not rigged, no animation: it is standing, so rotate -90 deg on X to lay it supine for the CPR scene. Crop/clip to the torso in the viewer if only the chest is needed.

title: Male Body
author: Alexander Antipov
notes: Second candidate: realistic-proportion adult male base mesh, standing A-pose, clean quad topology. No textures (single 'lambert1' material), so it takes any flat colour. Nude base mesh with modelled genitalia: frame from the waist up or clip the lower body. Not rigged, no animation.

title: IPAD SP1 Automated External Defibrillator – AED
author: R3D Reality
notes: Semi-automatic public-access AED (CU Medical i-PAD SP1): white case, front panel with pad-placement diagram, numbered steps 1-2-3, green power button, orange shock button, pad connector plug with a short cable stub. 2k GLB variant so the panel artwork stays legible. Named parts (Dutch): AED (body), Buttons, Stekker (plug), Snoertje (cable). No electrode pads and no animation: pads must be modelled as simple quads in the scene. Real product branding is visible.

title: CPR-Guide
author: XR Associates Malaysia
notes: Two overlapped hands in chest-compression position on a pink disc that stands in for the chest. Includes 1 animation clip ('Scene', 3 channels) with the push-down compression motion. 3 meshes: Cylinder (disc) and two hands; flat colour materials, no textures. Hide the Cylinder node to reuse the hands on top of torso.glb.

title: Medical First Aid Emergency Kit
author: RayznGames
notes: Open orange first-aid case filled with supplies (bandage rolls, cotton, scissors, syringe, creams, pill flasks). Slightly stylised game-prop look. 43 named meshes (MetalBox, MetalCover, BandAidRoll, Cotton, Scissor1, Syringe, PillFlask, ...) sharing one material (1k GLB variant). Uses KHR_materials_transmission and KHR_materials_specular. Decorative only: contents are generic, not a BLS-D kit.

title: Male Skeleton
author: projectkaizen
notes: Full adult male skeleton, standing A-pose (similar pose to torso.glb, but alignment between the two is not verified). 14 meshes split by material, usable to isolate the thorax: Ribs, Sternum, RibCartilage, Spine, Discs, plus ArmsHands, HipsLegs, Sacrum, HipCartilage, Hyoid, Cranium, UpperTeeth (mesh nodes are named Object_6..19, select by material name). Has 1 skin (rigged), no animation clips. 1k GLB variant.
